authorEntity.autopilot.title: Autopilot after a scan
authorEntity.autopilot.hint: Every minute, once no book was added for {{minutes}} min and local normalization is done, and while no LLM run and no entity pass is active (whoever started it): the never-asked names of the registered strata go to a resolve run, otherwise, if the selections changed, the entities are built. It never starts a check (eval) and never registers a stratum. A pause of {{minutes}} min within a long scan counts as quiet; the books after it are taken up by a later check.
